[[File:SplashDamage.png|20px|Explosive Damage]]50 (Destruction) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average |hidden = No }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Truck3''' was the original first vehicle spawned from the [[Military Base]], when it was at Level 3. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. A '''Truck3''' spawned at the start of every wave, one for every Level 3 [[Military Base]], then every 65 seconds after if the wave did not end. Unlike the [[Truck1]] and [[Truck2]], the '''Truck3''' had a mounted minigun which would attack enemies. While the '''Truck3''' dealt regular collision damage to enemies, upon its destruction, it dealt an additional 50 splash damage to any enemy caught within the explosion radius when it exploded. The '''Truck3''' was replaced by the [[Humvee 3]] after the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. ==Appearance== The '''Truck3''' was a green truck with an open bed. It had a diamond-plated dark green spiked bumper and a thick running board. '''Truck3''' had six metallic wheels and six headlamps. A humanoid stands on the open bed controlling a Gatling Gun. The humanoid has yellow skin, its torso was grey and its legs are dark grey. == Strategy == *The '''Truck3''' fares very well against slow enemies, like the [[Strong]] and [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], as well as hordes, due to its splash damage upon destruction. However, it does not fare so well against fast enemies such as the [[Shock|Lightning]] or [[Speedy Boss]]. **Be aware that you do not get any money from the '''Truck3''' colliding with enemies. However, you get money from any enemy damaged through its mounted gun. **While the '''Truck3''' can collide with [[Hidden]]s and [[Hidden Boss]]es, it cannot detect them. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Truck3''' will spawn per Level 3 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a specific path on these maps. *The [[Brute]], [[Tank|Tank 1]] and [[Tank 2]] can destroy the '''Truck3''' if a rock lands on it. **The '''Truck3''' can also be stunned, so that the mounted gun cannot attack, if it was caught in the ''Smash'' shockwave of the [[Gravekeeper]], or if a [[Boomer 1]] or [[Boomer 2]] exploded nearby. **The explosion of the '''Truck3''' upon destruction cannot damage enemies that are immune to [[Splash Damage]], such as the [[Golden]]. *The '''Truck3''' can target [[Shrike Crystal]]s, which makes them useful if other towers were stunned. == Trivia == *The '''Truck3''' was originally known as the '''Humvee3''', even though the appearance of the vehicle looked nothing like a [[wp:Humvee|Humvee]]. *The [[Humvee 3]] replaced '''Truck3''' in the MEGA Update. *The '''Truck3''' returned as a skin for the {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Humvee 3]], though it uses a different model. *The '''Truck3''' was based on the [[wp:M939 Truck|M939 Truck]]. == Update History == *'''10 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.4|BETA v1.4.0]] **'''Humvee3''' added. **{{Bug}} The spawnrate is longer by 5 seconds. *'''11 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.4|BETA v1.4.1]] **''Humvee3'' renamed to ''Truck3''. **Collisions no longer grant cash. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Truck3''' removed, replaced with [[Humvee 3]]. {{TowerNavBox}}
